title: Doodle Date: 1 Black Hole, 1 Taco, 2 Hearts
youtube_description:
First date. Two artists. One table. Zero small talk. — Doodle Date is a 39-second stick-figure short about two artists who try to out-draw each other on a first date, drawn entirely in ink on parchment with one crimson accent.

He opens with a rose, drawn from thin air. She counters with a diamond necklace; he wraps the whole table in a sports car. She answers with a jetpack, unleashes a dragon that eats his castle, and his tiny knight takes one look and quits. Panic makes him draw the one thing you never draw — a black hole that swallows the rose, the necklace, the car, the jetpack, the castle and the knight whole.

Silence. One cricket. Then the honest move: a taco. Her heart, his heart — they meet in the middle. Simple wins.

Every doodle date on this channel is drawn the same way: ink, parchment, one crimson accent and no mercy. If you like small ink-drawn stories about big feelings, subscribe — more doodles every week. And tell me below: what is the most unhinged thing you have ever drawn to impress someone, or attempted on a first date?

#shorts #animation #stickman #doodledate
